items.name: Mala Red Oil
items.desc: House-rendered beef tallow, 18 spices, Erjingtao chilies, and Sichuan peppercorn. The classic numbing-spicy base.

items.name: Mushroom Trio
items.desc: Wild porcini, shiitake, and enoki simmered with jujube and goji. Mild, earthy, comforting.

items.name: Split Pot (Yuan Yang)
items.desc: Mala red oil on one side, mushroom broth on the other. For tables that can't decide.

items.name: Tomato Beef Bone
items.desc: Slow-simmered beef bone broth with ripe tomato, onion, and a hint of rock sugar. Kid-friendly.

items.name: Wagyu Beef Slices
items.desc: Thinly sliced A4 marbled wagyu. Three seconds in the broth and it melts on the tongue.

items.name: Hand-Cut Beef Platter
items.desc: Fresh beef shank, hand-sliced to order, with tendon and a little fat for flavor.

items.name: Lamb Shoulder Roll
items.desc: Rolled lamb shoulder with a strip of fat. Cajun-spiced lamb, perfect for the red broth.

items.name: Black Pork Belly
items.desc: Iberico-style black pork belly, sliced thin. Rich, buttery, ideal for quick dipping.

items.name: Spicy Beef Tripe
items.desc: Hairy tripe, blanched in the pot for eight seconds. Crispy, chewy, smoky-spicy.

items.name: Duck Blood Curd
items.desc: Silken duck blood cake, our daily ritual. Locks in the broth, soft as custard.

items.name: Pork Meatballs
items.desc: Hand-chopped pork shoulder, mint, and ginger. Poach them yourself; do not overcook.

items.name: Quail Eggs
items.desc: Ten per skewer. Creamy yolk, alkaline-cured white. A hotpot staple since forever.

items.name: Lotus Root Slices
items.desc: Fresh lotus root, cut into coins. Crunchy, sweet, the perfect fire break.

items.name: Hand-Torn Tofu
items.desc: Pressed tofu from a Chengdu workshop. Soaks up broth like a sponge, won't fall apart.

items.name: Cilantro Bunches
items.desc: Whole-leaf cilantro for the quick dip. A fragrant, citrusy punch between bites.

items.name: Hand-Pulled Noodles
items.desc: Lanzhou-style hand-pulled noodles. Stretch, drop, cook 90 seconds. The perfect last bite.
